name: aylayoo-web
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project aylayoo-web --web
// deploy: Deploys to Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext, the same way goal-tracker-web does. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is inlined by `next build`, so the deploy targets set it inline — a Worker var would arrive too late to reach the client bundle.

options.// port: 3000 because aylayoo-service's ALLOWED_ORIGINS only permits localhost:3000 and :5173.

options.// why: One-off: turns the design mockup's 41 inline base64 photos into public/images/*.jpg. Already committed; re-run only if the mockup's photos change.
One-off: crops public/images/*.jpg into public/og/*.jpg at Open Graph's 1.905:1 for use as share cards. Already committed; re-run only if public/images changes. macOS only (uses sips).

preview.// why: Runs the built Worker locally in workerd, which is the only way to see what Cloudflare will actually serve. Points at the live API, because that is what the production bundle is built against.
preview.// why not in options: nx:run-commands forwards any key it does not recognise in `options` to the command line, so a comment key there became `bunx next build --// why=...` and the build failed with `unknown option '--//'`. At target level it is ignored. The `deploy` target has no comment inside `options`, which is why only `preview` broke.
